s1_overview.title: Project Overview
s1_overview.subtitle: What is StudySync and why was it built?
s1_overview.p1: StudySync is an all-in-one academic ecosystem designed to help university students manage their educational journey, tracking courses, lectures, attendance, grades, and academic milestones via a single centralized platform.
s1_overview.p2: The platform bridges students, professors, teaching assistants, and academic administrators, empowering each user with role-specific capabilities. Furthermore, it incorporates AI-driven tools to assist students with career-aligned course selection, lecture summarization, practice question generation, and personalized study schedules.
s1_overview.problemTitle: The Problem Addressed by the System:
s1_overview.problemText: The project solves the pervasive fragmentation of academic services across disparate apps, social groups, and isolated systems. Lecture slides reside in one place, official announcements in another, while attendance and grades are tracked on separate spreadsheets. StudySync consolidates all these workflows into a cohesive, intuitive platform.

s3_roles.title: System Users & Roles
s3_roles.subtitle: Dedicated permissions tailored for every stakeholder in the academic ecosystem

roles.name: Student
roles.summary: The center of the educational experience, equipped with a comprehensive cockpit for academics and career planning.
permissions: View enrolled courses with instant access to lectures, lab notes, and resources.
Track announcements per course and receive real-time updates upon publishing.
Check in via dynamic rotating QR code scanning during lectures and lab sections.
Monitor personal attendance rates and remaining allowed absences before deprivation.
Inspect grades and assessment breakdowns immediately after professor accreditation.
Receive proactive early academic warnings when attendance or scores dip.
Track milestones, quiz dates, midterm schedules, and assignment deadlines.
Create private tasks, rich notes, and attachments in their secure personal workspace.
Select desired career tracks and receive tailored course recommendations.
Generate concise summaries and flashcard practice questions directly from lecture files using AI.
Obtain an automated, adaptive study schedule aligned with academic deadlines.
Receive curated notifications for external internships, hackathons, and certified workshops.

roles.name: Professor / Faculty Member
roles.summary: Full authority to manage courses, upload scientific materials, publish evaluations, and initiate attendance sessions.
permissions: Manage and configure academic course syllabus and learning outcomes.
Publish lecture slides, reference materials, and urgent course announcements.
Initiate secure attendance sessions with auto-refreshing dynamic QR codes.
Input, review, and finalize grades for quizzes, midterms, and project coursework.
Propose makeup lecture times with automatic student schedule conflict resolution.
Monitor cohort academic health and identify students at academic risk.

roles.name: Teaching Assistant (TA)
roles.summary: Oversees lab sections, manages programming/practical assignments, and audits section attendance.
permissions: Upload lab section sheets, code templates, and hands-on assignment briefs.
Run lab attendance check-ins and review validated excused absences.
Grade student assignments with contextual feedback and rubric notes.
Provide direct technical mentorship and answer section inquiries.
Deliver weekly section progress summaries to course professors.

roles.name: Academic Administrator
roles.summary: Administers degree plans, reviews machine-learning track classifications (HITL), and accredits opportunities.
permissions: Configure degree requirements, credit hour limits, and prerequisite/corequisite rules.
Audit and approve ML-generated course-to-career-track mappings (Human-In-The-Loop).
Verify and publish external internship and hackathon opportunities.
Issue formal academic warning letters and deprivation notices for critical attendance deficits.
Import/export student grade books and synchronize with university SIS infrastructure.

s5_attendance.title: Smart Attendance & Absence System
s5_attendance.subtitle: Instant dynamic QR check-in with anti-proxy protection and deprivation countdown

features.title: Fast & Secure Attendance Sessions
features.desc: The instructor starts a timed session displaying a dynamic QR code that refreshes every few seconds to prevent photo forwarding.

features.title: Tamper-Proof QR Characteristics
features.desc: Encoded with a time-limited cryptographic token tied to the specific session, permitting only one scan per authenticated student account.

features.title: Dual Verification & Manual Fallback
features.desc: Server checks session validity and duplicate prevention, with a manual override option (Present / Absent / Late / Excused) with audit log.

features.title: Geofencing Verification (Optional)
features.desc: Optional radius validation ensuring student presence within lecture hall vicinity during the scan moment only, preserving full privacy.

features.title: Deprivation Counter & Live Ratios
features.desc: Real-time calculation of presence, absences, and tardiness, showing exact remaining missed lectures before reaching the critical 75% threshold.

interactive.scannedSuccess: Attendance confirmed! Cryptographic token and classroom geofence validated.

s6_grades.title: Grading, Assessments & Academic Risk Detection
s6_grades.subtitle: Transparent grade recording with a proactive rules-based early warning matrix
s6_grades.intro: Supports all assessment archetypes: Assignments, Quizzes, Midterms, Final Exams, Projects, Practical Labs, and Participation. Saved as draft prior to official publication with instantaneous push alerts to students.

levels.name: Safe
levels.condition: Attendance > 85%, all assignments submitted, and scores above passing threshold
levels.message: Your academic standing is stable and excellent.

levels.name: Attention Required
levels.condition: Attendance between 76% and 84%, or 1 missing assignment
levels.message: Regular attendance is advised to prevent escalation.

levels.name: At Risk
levels.condition: Attendance nearing 75% (deprivation limit), or 2+ missing assignments
levels.message: Your attendance is 77% (threshold: 75%). An additional absence will trigger deprivation!

levels.name: Critical Risk
levels.condition: Attendance ≤ 75% (exceeded deprivation limit) or failing initial exam scores
levels.message: Permissible absence limit exceeded. Contact your academic advisor immediately.

s11_ai_track.title: AI Model: Course-to-Career Track Mapping
s11_ai_track.subtitle: Machine Learning (Multi-label Text Classification) for Career Guidance
s11_ai_track.intro: Maps academic courses to real-world career tracks (e.g., Mobile Dev, Backend, Data Engineering) by extracting syllabus context and learning outcomes.
s11_ai_track.modelType: Model Type: Multi-label Text Classification (a single course can serve multiple professional career tracks concurrently).
features: Tools & Tech Stacks (Flutter, SQL, Dart, etc.)
s11_ai_track.hitlDesc: The model proposes tracks with confidence scores (e.g., Mobile Dev 95%, Software Eng 72%). They are not auto-approved; the Academic Admin audits them, and adjustments continuously retrain the model.
s11_ai_track.algorithms: Recommended Architecture: TF-IDF + One-vs-Rest Logistic Regression (ultra-fast baseline with no GPU overhead) • Linear SVM • Sentence Embeddings + Neural Networks.

s12_recommendation.title: Student Subject Recommendation Engine
s12_recommendation.subtitle: Staged filtering ensuring strict regulatory compliance before individual preferences
stage1Items: Exclude subjects previously passed by the student.
Exclude courses not offered in the current semester.
Verify completion of all mandatory Prerequisites.
Ensure registration of required concurrent Corequisites.
Enforce maximum allowed credit hour registration ceilings.
Verify course suitability for the student's actual academic year.
s12_recommendation.stage2Title: Stage 2: Adaptive Weighted Ranking of Eligible Subjects
s12_recommendation.formula: Recommendation Score = (Track Relevance × 45%) + (Skill Match × 30%) + (Workload Preference × 15%) + (Student Interest × 10%)
s12_recommendation.explainable: Complete Explainable AI transparency: reasons for every recommendation are explicitly detailed, granting full freedom of enrollment without coercion.

quizDemo.title: Try Instant AI Practice Question Generator (Interactive Demo):
quizDemo.question: What is the primary architectural difference between a Stack and a Queue in Data Structures?
options: Stack operates via LIFO while Queue operates via FIFO
Stack has infinite size while Queue has fixed capacity
Queue operates via LIFO while Stack operates via FIFO
quizDemo.feedback: Correct! A Stack operates on Last-In-First-Out, whereas a Queue operates on First-In-First-Out principle.

s17_value.questionsTitle: The platform answers the 8 vital daily questions every university student faces:

questions.q: 01. What subjects am I eligible to enroll in this semester?
questions.a: Instant automated filtering of unlocked courses meeting prerequisite and credit hour rules.

questions.q: 02. Why is the system preventing me from registering for a specific course?
questions.a: Clear, explicit explanations such as missing prerequisite or course not being scheduled.

questions.q: 03. Which subject is most beneficial for my future career track?
questions.a: ML-powered recommendations analyzing syllabus vectors mapped to your chosen profession.

questions.q: 04. What specifically should I study and focus on right now?
questions.a: A dynamic 'What should I do next?' list ranked by an algorithmic priority formula.

questions.q: 05. When is my nearest impending assignment or examination deadline?
questions.a: A synchronized calendar with live countdown clocks warning you ahead of time.

questions.q: 06. Is my absence rate approaching the critical deprivation threshold?
questions.a: A transparent absence counter displaying exact remaining allowed misses before the 75% limit.

questions.q: 07. What external training opportunities match my skills and major?
questions.a: A verified opportunity portal linking you with summer internships and hackathons tailored to your level.

questions.q: 08. What new lecture content or urgent announcements were posted?
questions.a: Direct targeted alerts with zero noise or reliance on informal chat groups.
